title: Human Liver Spheroids from Peripheral Blood for Liver Disease Studies
protocol: Extract 30 mL of blood from healthy donors with the help of trained medical personnel according to the standard protocol.
Isolate PBMNCs using density gradient media according to the published protocol.
Pipette the interphase layer between plasma and density gradient media for isolation of cells.
Wash isolated cells with sterile phosphate buffer saline (PBS).
Use a counting chamber and count the number of cells using standard methods.
Place 6 x 10^6 mononuclear cells in PBS/1% bovine serum albumin (BSA) in a polystyrene tube (15 mL).
Incubate cells with specific antibody for 30 min at 37 °C according to the published protocol.
Centrifuge the cells at 300 x g at room temperature.
Replace PBS/BSA with Iscove's modified Dulbecco's medium supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS).
Grow cells in 15 mL polystyrene tubes in a 5% CO2 incubator at 37 °C for 8-10 days according to the published protocol.
Add 1-2 mL of Iscove's medium supplemented with 10% FBS to each 15 mL tube on day 5 (D5).
Centrifuge cultured cell suspension at room temperature for 10 min at 300 x g.
Aspirate the supernatant from the centrifuged cells using a sterile pipette.
Resuspend the pellet in 90 μL of cold PBS buffer (pH 7.2, 0.5% BSA, and 2 mM EDTA).
Add 10 μL of CD45 positive nano-sized magnetic beads to the cell suspension.
Incubate on ice for 15 min.
Wash the cell suspension with 2 mL of PBS buffer.
Centrifuge the washed cells at 300 x g for 10 min at room temperature.
Resuspend thoroughly in 500 μL of PBS buffer.
Pipette 500 μL of pre-cooled PBS buffer into a column and place it in a magnetic field using a magnetic stand.
Wash the cells on the column twice with 500 μL of PBS buffer.
Collect flow-through containing CD45 negative cells in Iscove's medium supplemented with 10% FBS.
Separate glass coverslips (14 mm) and incubate them in nonionic detergent for 10 min.
Wash the coverslips in deionized water until no bubbles remain.
Incubate coverslips in 1M HCl for 30 min.
Wash the coverslips with deionized water at least three times.
Dry the coverslips overnight at room temperature.
Autoclave dried glass coverslips in a suitable container.
Place autoclaved glass coverslips in 4 well plates using sterile tweezers.
Expose the coverslips to UV light for 30 minutes.
Thaw aliquots of biolaminin and add 120 μL of a 5 µg/mL biolaminin solution to each cover slip.
Incubate coated glass coverslips overnight at 4 °C.
Remove excess biolaminin from the coverslips.
Add 200 μL of hepatocyte differentiation medium to each well.

Prepare 500 mL of hepatoblast knockout serum replacement (KSR)/dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) medium by mixing 76.4% KO-DMEM, 20% KSR, 0.5% L-glutamine, 1% NEAA, 0.1% β-mercaptoethanol, 1% DMSO, and 1% Pen/Strep.
Prepare 500 mL of hepatocyte maturation medium by mixing 1% L-glutamine, 10 µM HCC, and 1% Pen/Strep.
Aliquot the hepatocyte differentiation medium from stock.
Add fresh hepatocyte growth factor (HGF) at a final concentration of 10 ng/mL or 20 ng/mL to the medium.
Add fresh oncostatin M (OSM) at a final concentration of 10 ng/mL or 20 ng/mL to the medium.
Place 3 x 10^5 BD-PSCS cells into each well of a 4-well plate coated with biolaminin.
Place the 4-well plates in the incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Culture the cells for 5 days in KSR/DMSO hepatoblast medium.
Change the medium every second day.
Switch to hepatocyte maturation medium on day 5.
Culture the cells for an additional 7-10 days in the incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Change the medium every 48 h.
Count cells using a counting chamber.
Centrifuge BD-dedifferentiated cell suspension at 300 x g for 10 min at room temperature.
Remove supernatant and resuspend BD-dedifferentiated cells in KSR/DMSO medium at 2 x 10^6 cells/mL.
Pass the cells through a 40 µm cell strainer to ensure a single-cell suspension and to remove any additional debris.
Prepare a gradient with top seeding of 1 x 10^6 cells to a low seeding density of 4000 cells.
Dispense 100 µL of KSR/DMSO medium in 96 well-low attachment plates.
Add 100 µL of cell seeding dilution.
Place the low attachment plate in the incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Culture the cells for 5 days.
Change 50% of the medium from days 3-4 after seeding when the spheroids are sufficiently compact.
On day 5, change the medium to hepatocyte maturation medium.
Culture the cells for an additional 7-10 days for further maturation.
Change the medium every second day.
Culture cells according to the differentiation method described for 4, 8, 15, and 24 days.
Remove media from the cultured cells.
Incubate cells with pre-warmed fixative consisting of 4% paraformaldehyde in PBS for 10 min.
Discard the fixative and wash the cells 2x with PBS for 5 min each.
Immediately add 0.1% triton X-100 solution to permeabilize the cells for 5 min.
Wash the cells 2x with PBS.
Add blocking solution made of PBS and 5% BSA and place on rocker plate for 1 h at room temperature.

Dilute primary antibodies in dilution buffer 1% BSA/PBS: albumin (ALB) 1:50, alpha-1 fetoprotein (AFP) 1:250, cytokeratin 18 (CK18) 1:50, hepatocyte nuclear factor 4 alpha (HNF4α) 1:1000 and transthyretin (TTR) 1:50.
Use 50 µL of antibody dilution per well.
Incubate the cells for 1 h at room temperature.
Discard the antibody solution, wash the cells for 5 min, then repeat washing step 3x.
Prepare secondary antibodies in dilution buffer: rabbit anti-chicken IgG (Texas red) 1:1000, goat anti-mouse IgG (488) 1:1000, and goat anti-rabbit (488) 1:500.
Use 50 µL of antibody dilution per well.
Incubate the cells for 30 min at room temperature.
Wash the cells 3x with PBS for 5 min each.
Mount coverslips with mounting media containing DAPI for microscopic analysis.
Discard culture media without touching the spheroids.
Add freshly made PBS with 0.1% triton X-100 and incubate for 5 min to permeabilize cells.
Wash the spheroids with medium by pipetting slowly for 5 min; repeat twice.
Incubate spheroids with primary antibodies ALB, AFP, CK18, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 in PBS with 1% BSA for 1 h at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Remove excess antibody solution carefully and wash the spheroids three times with medium.
Prepare secondary antibodies goat anti-mouse IgG (Cy3), goat anti-mouse IgG (488), and rabbit anti-chicken IgG (Texas red) at dilutions of 1:1000 and 1:500 for goat anti-rabbit (488).
Incubate spheroids with secondary antibodies in PBS with 1% BSA for 20 min at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Wash the spheroids three times with medium and leave on the stage for 30 min at 37 °C, 5% CO2 before microscopy.
Switch on fluorescence light source 10 min prior to use.
Turn on computer and open imaging software.
Use an objective with 4x magnification.
Select correct scale bar by clicking button 4x in toolbar.
Place the 96-well plate on the stage center.
Turn the LED light source on.
Use the brightfield filter.
Position the plate to the well of interest using the x-y-axis stage adjustment knob.
Change to camera light path.
Click the button Live in imaging software to visualize the image on the screen.
Ensure the spheroid is centered using the x-y-axis knobs.
Focus using the coarse/fine focus knob.
Choose the Brightfield Observation method in the toolbar.
Put exposure settings to automatic.
Click the button Snapshot in the camera control panel to take a picture.
Save the picture as .vsi file using the appropriate name in the folder of interest.
Place ambient light shielding plate to turn off LED light.
Change to filter for B-excitation.
Choose 488 Observation method in the toolbar.
Open shutter.
Take a picture by clicking button Snapshot.
Close shutter.
Save file as described above.
Repeat this with a filter for G-excitation using the appropriate observation method (Texas red or CY3).
Reiterate the whole procedure for each well of interest.
Return the plate to the 5% CO2 incubator at 37 °C.
